The petitioners had preferred these Writ 
Petitions against the order of termination of their 
respective services. 
The respondents, who are represented by the 
learned Brief Holder, was granted time to file the 
counter affidavit by an order of 24th November, 
2021, but the same has not yet been filed. 
The learned Brief Holder prays for and is 
granted further three weeks’ time to file the counter 
affidavit. 
List these Writ Petitions, as soon as the 
counter affidavit is filed by the respondents or 
three weeks expires, whichever is earlier.
